title: Adding Service Parts renames the first field and copies the person
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A.
  • Create a customer for this test whose one Sales Representative is sales rep A.
  • Open the customer's Edit Customer window in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps:
1. Hover over the + beside Sales Representative.
  2. Click the +.
  3. Click "Sales Representative - Service Parts".
  4. Click the + again.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The tooltip reads "Add representative".

Step 2:

  • The menu lists, in this order, "Sales Representative - Service Parts" and "Sales Representative - Part Sales".

Step 3:

  • The first field is renamed "Sales Representative - Service Labor".
  • "Sales Representative - Service Parts" shows under it.
  • Both read sales rep A.
  • No dropdown opens on its own.
  • Service Parts has a remove x.

Step 4:

  • The menu now lists only "Sales Representative - Part Sales".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 13 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R5: “The + button of S2-R1 to S2-R3 sits to the right of the first field, with the tooltip "Add representative".”
  • S4-R6: “Its menu lists, in this order, each field not yet added: "Sales Representative - Service Parts" and "Sales Representative - Part Sales". When both are added the + is not shown.”
  • S4-R7: “Adding Service Parts renames the first field "Sales Representative - Service Labor" and shows "Sales Representative - Service Parts" under it. Both start with the person who was in the first field, or "Unassigned". When that person's Sales Representative switch is off or their account is deactivated, the first field keeps them, as "Elliot Brennan (Inactive)" (S4-N2), and the added Service Parts field starts "Unassigned".”
  • S4-R10: “Service Parts and Part Sales each have the remove x of S2-R8 to their right, with the tooltip "Remove Sales Representative - Service Parts" or "Remove Sales Representative - Part Sales". The first field has the + instead, while there is something left to add, and otherwise no button.”
  • S4-R15: “Neither dropdown opens on its own after a field is added.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
